Title: App crashes on startup after upgrade

arguments.body:
**Triage note**

- **Category:** Bug (regression — crash on startup after upgrade)
- **Severity:** High — the application is completely unusable for all users (blocks launch), so this warrants immediate attention.
- **Suggested next steps:**
  - Reproduce against the previous release to confirm this is an upgrade regression.
  - Capture the startup crash log / stack trace (device or emulator) and attach it here.
  - Check recent changes around app initialization, dependency injection, and any new native library or SDK linked into the build.
  - If the crash only occurs after upgrade, verify database/schema migrations and stored-preference/keychain handling for backward compatibility.

Please add logs or a stack trace to help root-cause this quickly.
